title: Priority Foregrounds Kanban
one_liner: A local-first workbench for deterministic product prioritization using a fixed 100-point budget and optional AI-assisted scoring.
what_it_is: A standalone web application that helps product operators make explicit tradeoffs by allocating a strict 100-point budget across five decision principles. It features a deterministic queue ranking system, responsive UI for editing principles, and an optional AI evaluator that proposes scores based on structured prompts while enforcing strict validation contracts to prevent malformed data injection.
how_its_built: The backend is a lightweight Python HTTP server using the standard library (http.server) to serve static assets and handle API requests. The frontend is a vanilla JavaScript single-page application managing state in browser local storage. AI integration uses the Google Gemini API via a bounded rescore module that enforces rate limits, token budgets, and strict schema validation before accepting any proposed scores.
how_to_apply: Use this tool to replace subjective gut-feel prioritization with a transparent, auditable process. Define your five key decision principles (e.g., Customer Value, Risk, Leverage), assign them weights summing to 100, and input your initiative queue. Use the AI rescoring feature to get consistent, evidence-based scoring suggestions for each principle, then manually review and accept changes to maintain human-in-the-loop control.
features: Enforces an exact 100-point budget across five editable decision principles with proportional redistribution.
Deterministic queue ranking that reorders initiatives only after user interaction completes.
Optional AI evaluator that proposes complete score columns with concise reasons, rejecting partial or malformed output.
Strict validation contract ensuring every initiative ID is scored exactly once with integer values between 1 and 5.
Local storage persistence for scores, reasons, prompt state, and model provenance without external databases.
Built-in spend controls including per-minute and per-day rate limits and token budgets for AI calls.
